basics.name: Daniel Edward Mwihoti
basics.label: Software Developer | Full-Stack Engineer | Blockchain & AI Developer
basics.summary: Software Developer with 3+ years of experience building full-stack web applications, blockchain systems, and AI automation tools for remote teams worldwide. Skilled across the modern stack — TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Rust, and PostgreSQL — with deep, hands-on expertise in smart contracts, wallet infrastructure, and AI agent development. Open-source contributor to five major ecosystem projects including Payjoin (rust-payjoin), IntersectMBO (Cardano), the Cardano Foundation, rust-bitcoin, and the Stacks explorer. 20+ products delivered, 6+ deployed live. Open to freelance contracts and remote roles worldwide.

work.name: Freelance / Remote
work.summary: Built and shipped 20+ full-stack products, blockchain applications, Telegram bots, and AI automation tools. Developed Open Wallet Standard (multi-chain AI agent wallet, 9 networks, policy-gated signing) and Bitcoin Wallet Lab (educational Rust wallet on Testnet4: secp256k1, ECDSA/RFC 6979, P2PKH + Nested/Native SegWit). Designed AI-powered assistants and automation workflows integrating LLMs with backend systems. Delivered production apps with React/Next.js, Node.js/Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, and CI/CD.

work.name: Blockchain Centre NBO, Nairobi
work.summary: Build Cardano dApps and Next.js developer tools (Plutus, Mesh SDK) in the centre's technical programmes. Conduct research across Cardano, Bitcoin, and Starknet ecosystems; represent the centre at events including the Cardano Africa Tech Summit and Cardano Corner at Africa Tech Summit.

work.name: Kenya Tea Development Agency (KTDA)
work.summary: Configured the Pesa-Ulipo application on KTDA Wizarpos devices for financial operations across field sites. Resolved Microsoft Dynamics NAV issues; analysed business datasets with SQL.

volunteer.summary: Global builder network growing the Avalanche ecosystem; Mini Hack Cohort 2 build program.
Contributed to the reference Rust implementation of Payjoin (BIP 77 / BIP 78, privacy-preserving Bitcoin payment batching); pull request reviewed and merged upstream.
Refactored Internal.Arena with modern Haskell record extensions in a production-grade LSM database library used in Cardano infrastructure.
Added Kenya-specific ADA on-ramp exchange listings; contributed Docker-based local development support for reproducible contributor workflows.
Contributions to the foundational Rust Bitcoin library and the Stacks blockchain explorer — blockchain infrastructure and developer-facing tooling.

projects.name: OmniCaption AI
projects.description: Multi-agent video-intelligence platform (13 specialized AI agents) producing transcripts, accessibility descriptions, emotion timelines, and social captions, with a factual-grounding + hallucination-verification loop. React, FastAPI/Python, Whisper; deployed on AMD ROCm. Built for the AMD Developer Hackathon.

projects.name: Certified Chain
projects.description: Blockchain credential-issuance platform on Cardano: certificate NFTs via Mesh SDK/Blockfrost, an Aiken on-chain revocation contract, and a zero-knowledge privacy layer (Midnight Network) so only hashes touch the chain. Next.js, TypeScript, Neon Postgres, IPFS/Pinata.

projects.name: Personal AI Agent — Bitcoin OSS Triage Bot
projects.description: Autonomous agent that scans GitHub repositories daily for high-signal contribution opportunities (good-first-issue, help-wanted, bugs), analyzes them with an LLM, and delivers a prioritized digest via Telegram (@btc_opensource_projects_bot). Node.js, Gemini/Groq/Ollama, Airtable, cron scheduling.

projects.name: BobOpenSource
projects.description: AI developer tool that analyzes a GitHub repo and issue, maps dependencies, and generates an implementation roadmap with code guidance and risk notes, plus an interactive "Ask Bob" Q&A. Next.js, React, Node.js, GitHub API, Neon Postgres, Clerk.

projects.name: StackMate
projects.description: Builder-partner marketplace on Bitcoin L2 (Stacks). Four Clarity smart contracts on mainnet anchor registration, applications, acceptances, and endorsements into a verifiable on-chain reputation trail.

projects.name: Open Wallet Standard
projects.description: Multi-chain AI agent wallet supporting 9 networks (EVM, Solana, Cosmos, Bitcoin, XRPL) with policy-gated signing so agents can act without exposure to raw private keys.

projects.name: Bitcoin Wallet Lab
projects.description: Educational Rust wallet on Testnet4 implementing secp256k1, ECDSA signing (RFC 6979), and P2PKH, Nested SegWit, and Native SegWit address generation.

projects.name: Memorabilia
projects.description: On-chain memory-card game on Starknet (Cairo, Dojo Engine), playable as a Telegram Mini App with account-abstraction wallets, gasless interaction, and NFT minting.

projects.name: Daily Habit Hub
projects.description: Fitness-tracking dApp on Avalanche (Next.js, Supabase, Wagmi, RainbowKit) with daily streaks, token incentives, and NFT-based "Proof of Progress" rewards.
